zh.title: Cessna Citation CJ1於賓州起飛時墜毀起火，兩人受傷
zh.summary: Cessna Citation CJ1在賓州起飛時墜毀起火，兩人受傷
body: 一架 Cessna Citation CJ1於2026年10月7日在賓州 Bedford County Airport 起飛時墜毀並起火。美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）表示，事故約於當地時間上午10時45分、飛機離場期間發生，該機構正在調查。
飛行員與副駕駛均生還，兩人傷勢不危及生命，並被送往 Bedford Hospital；AeroTime引述當地電視臺 FOX8 報導，該臺消息來自緊急應變官員。Bedford Fire Chief Gary Cooper表示，飛機疑似衝出跑道、越過道路，停在附近田地；消防人員抵達時，飛機已被火焰吞沒。

en.title: Cessna Citation CJ1 crashes and catches fire during takeoff in Pennsylvania
en.summary: A Cessna Citation CJ1 crashed and caught fire during takeoff; both occupants survived with non-life-threatening injuries.
body: A Cessna Citation CJ1 crashed and caught fire during takeoff at Bedford County Airport in Pennsylvania on October 7, 2026. The Federal Aviation Administration said the crash occurred at about 10:45 a.m. local time during departure and that it is investigating.

The pilot and copilot survived with non-life-threatening injuries and were taken to Bedford Hospital, AeroTime reported, citing local station FOX8, which cited emergency officials. Bedford Fire Chief Gary Cooper said the jet appeared to have left the runway, crossed a road and stopped in a nearby field. It was engulfed in flames when firefighters arrived.

zh.title: 易捷航空削減冬季航班班表 涉及70萬個座位
zh.summary: 易捷航空削減冬季航班班表，涉及70萬個座位；報導稱因應燃油價格上漲
body: Simple Flying報導，易捷航空（easyJet）大幅削減冬季航班時刻表，涉及70萬個座位。報導標題稱這是「再削減」70萬個座位，所指措施為冬季班表及座位供給縮減。
報導摘要稱，中東戰事推高噴射燃油價格，易捷航空因而削減無利可圖的航線。摘要將燃油價格上升與航線削減列為因應關係，並把受削減航線描述為無利可圖。

en.title: easyJet Cuts Winter Schedule, Removing 700,000 Seats
en.summary: easyJet cuts its winter schedule by 700,000 seats; the report links the cuts to fuel prices.
body: Simple Flying reports that easyJet is making major cuts to its winter schedule, with 700,000 seats being removed. The headline calls this “another” 700,000-seat reduction. The reported change concerns the winter schedule and seat capacity.

The report summary says war in the Middle East has boosted jet fuel prices and that the airline has cut unprofitable routes in response. Its account links the route cuts to the higher fuel costs and describes the routes as unprofitable.

zh.title: RwandAir執行長呼籲為非洲航空市場落實設定期限
zh.summary: RwandAir執行長呼籲為非洲單一航空市場落實設定期限
body: 第10屆 Aviation Africa Summit 於2026年9月9日至10日在 Sarit Expo Centre 舉行。RwandAir 執行長 Yvonne Makolo 在航空公司場次表示，政府、民航主管機關及航空公司應為落實非洲單一航空運輸市場設定明確期限，並推動執行，而非停留於討論與簽署。
AFRAA表示，2026年8月非洲座位運能年增8.8%，其中非洲內部運能增加10.5%。ICAO資料顯示，SAATM有38個非洲聯盟成員國參與，代表非洲內部航空運量逾八成。ICAO另報告，非洲內部連通性由14.5%升至23%；非洲業者於2022年9月至2025年4月新增108條航線。Kenya Airways與RwandAir也同意將各自代碼延伸至樞紐以外的目的地。

en.title: RwandAir chief urges deadlines for implementing Africa’s single aviation market
en.summary: RwandAir’s chief urged fixed deadlines to implement Africa’s single aviation market.
body: At the 10th Aviation Africa Summit, held at the Sarit Expo Centre on September 9 and 10, 2026, RwandAir chief executive Yvonne Makolo said governments, civil aviation authorities and airlines needed fixed deadlines for implementing the Single African Air Transport Market (SAATM). She said the industry needed to move beyond talking and signing and deliver implementation.

AFRAA reported that African seat capacity rose 8.8% year on year in August 2026, with intra-African capacity up 10.5%. ICAO reported that SAATM counted 38 African Union member states, representing more than 80% of intra-African traffic. ICAO also reported intra-African connectivity rising from 14.5% to 23%, and African operators launching 108 new routes between September 2022 and April 2025. Kenya Airways and RwandAir agreed to extend their codes to destinations beyond their respective hubs.

zh.title: Edgewing在義大利杜林啟用GCAP首座工程中心
zh.summary: Edgewing於義大利杜林啟用首座GCAP工程中心，負責未來戰機系統工程
body: Edgewing於10月8日在義大利正式啟用首座工程中心。中心設於杜林，緊鄰GCAP合作夥伴Leonardo的設施，將負責GCAP未來戰機的系統與子系統工程工作。
Edgewing預期，至2027年底，中心將有來自英國、義大利及日本的300多名員工。公司另規劃興建第二棟建築，並預計在完整運作規模時員工人數將超過1,000人。杜林是Edgewing三座工程中心中的首座，另外兩座預定於未來數週跟進。

en.title: Edgewing opens first GCAP engineering hub in Italy
en.summary: Edgewing opened its first GCAP engineering hub in Turin, Italy, for future fighter systems work.
body: Edgewing officially opened its first engineering hub in Italy on 8 October. Located in Turin beside facilities of GCAP partner Leonardo, the site will handle engineering work on systems and subsystems for the programme’s future fighter.

Edgewing expects more than 300 employees from the UK, Italy and Japan to be based at the hub by the end of 2027. The company also plans a second building, with more than 1,000 employees expected at full capacity. Turin is the first of three engineering hubs, with two more set to follow in the coming weeks.

zh.title: 沙烏地阿拉伯航空機師在利雅德機場（RUH）遇襲身亡 一架客機受損
zh.summary: 沙烏地阿拉伯航空機師在利雅德機場遇襲身亡；一架停放客機受損，機上無乘客
body: 沙烏地阿拉伯航空（Saudia）證實，一名機師在2026年10月8日於利雅德哈立德國王國際機場（RUH）遭受的攻擊中身亡，該公司一架客機也在攻擊中受損。
該航空公司公佈殉職機師為Captain Hamoud Ali al-Kalthami，並表示受損客機當時停放於機場，機上沒有乘客。
AeroTime報導指出，這項宣佈是在路透社報導之後發布；路透社稱沙烏地阿拉伯航空一架客機停放於機場航廈時嚴重受損並起火，其引述的消息人士表示，損害可能來自掉落的飛彈碎片或直接遭投射物擊中。
沙烏地阿拉伯航空並未說明涉及的是哪一架客機，也未進一步交代機師死亡情況的相關細節。
葉門青年運動組織（Houthi movement）聲稱，2026年10月8日針對哈立德國王國際機場的彈道飛彈攻擊是其所為。沙烏地阿拉伯領導的聯軍表示，已在利雅德上空攔截兩枚彈道飛彈。
報導指出，這起攻擊發生在2026年10月6日與7日利雅德及艾卜哈機場先前遭攻擊之後；沙烏地阿拉伯航空主管機關表示，那些攻擊造成三人死亡、36人受傷。
利雅德機場2026年10月8日的空中交通嚴重受擾。根據航空分析公司Cirium的資料，當天該機場378個排定離場航班中有169個取消或未運作，另有數家國際航空公司暫停飛往沙烏地阿拉伯首都的服務。

en.title: Saudia pilot killed, aircraft damaged in attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport (RUH)
en.summary: Saudia pilot killed and one of its parked aircraft damaged at Riyadh airport on October 8; no passengers on board
body: Saudia has confirmed that a pilot was killed and one of the airline's aircraft was damaged during an attack on King Khalid International Airport (RUH) in Riyadh on October 8, 2026.

The Saudi flag carrier identified the pilot as Captain Hamoud Ali al-Kalthami. It said one of its aircraft was damaged while parked at the airport and confirmed that no passengers were on board at the time.

The announcement follows reports by Reuters that a Saudia aircraft had sustained extensive damage and caught fire while parked at an airport terminal. Sources cited by the news agency said the damage could have resulted from falling missile debris or a direct projectile strike.
The airline has not identified the aircraft involved or provided further details about the circumstances of the pilot's death.

Yemen's Houthi movement claimed responsibility for the ballistic missile attack targeting King Khalid International Airport on October 8, 2026. The Saudi-led coalition said it had intercepted two ballistic missiles over Riyadh.
The attack came after earlier strikes on Riyadh and Abha airports on October 6 and 7, 2026, which Saudi aviation authorities said killed three people and injured 36.

Air traffic at Riyadh was severely disrupted on October 8. According to aviation analytics firm Cirium, 169 of the airport's 378 scheduled departures were canceled or did not operate that day, while several international carriers suspended services to the Saudi capital.

zh.title: IATA籲各國政府在CORSIA十週年強化航空排放框架
zh.summary: IATA於CORSIA十週年呼籲政府強化全球航空排放框架
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）在國際民用航空組織（ICAO）大會決議設立國際航空碳抵換及減量計畫（CORSIA）十週年之際，呼籲各國政府強化這項全球航空排放框架。CORSIA於2016年ICAO大會通過；IATA指出，該計畫建立了首個適用於單一產業的全球市場機制。
IATA表示，目前有超過130個國家參與CORSIA，並預計該計畫至年底可減緩約2億公噸二氧化碳排放。歐盟正考慮將EU ETS延伸至以法蘭克福為中心、5,000公里範圍內的目的地等提案；IATA主張，相關檢討應強化CORSIA作為國際航空全球框架的角色，而非鼓勵重疊的區域或雙邊制度。

en.title: IATA urges governments to strengthen CORSIA on its 10th anniversary
en.summary: IATA marks CORSIA’s 10th anniversary and urges governments to reinforce the global framework.
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) marked the 10th anniversary of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Assembly resolution establishing the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA), calling on governments to strengthen the framework. Adopted at the 2016 ICAO Assembly, CORSIA established what IATA described as the first global market-based measure for an industrial sector.

IATA said more than 130 countries participate in CORSIA and estimated that the scheme would have mitigated about 200 million tonnes of CO2 by the end of the year. The European Union is considering proposals to extend its Emissions Trading System to destinations within 5,000 km, using Frankfurt as its geographic center. IATA said the review should reinforce CORSIA as the global framework for international aviation rather than encourage overlapping regional or bilateral systems.
